plugins.name: my-business-brain
plugins.description: A trusted memory for your business in English and Arabic, kept as plain files in your own folder: facts with sources, a record of every change, off-the-record privacy, a watch list and Sunday review, social chatter kept as leads rather than facts, briefings and a dashboard, and contract deadlines on your calendar.
